drafts.title: Troubleshooting gibberish output after LoRA fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-bnb-4bit for classification
drafts.body:
A user reported fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-bnb-4bit with LoRA for a classification task using about 3,000 training samples. Their LoRA setup included r=16, lora_alpha=16, lora_dropout=0, bias='none', and gradient checkpointing set to "unsloth". Training arguments specified a per-device batch size of 2 with gradient accumulation of 16, three epochs, a learning rate of 2e-4, and mixed precision (fp16 or bf16 depending on hardware), optimized with adamw_8bit.

Despite this, the model produces gibberish output roughly 40% of the time during prediction on test data after tuning. Since the cause is unclear, a key question is which diagnostic checks or metrics would best help distinguish whether the issue stems from data quality, LoRA hyperparameters, precision mode, or training stability. For example, would monitoring loss curves for overfitting or underfitting, validating data preprocessing consistency, or testing different precision settings provide useful insights? Clarifying these could help isolate the root cause in this documented configuration.

drafts.title: LoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-bnb-4bit用于分类后出现乱码输出的故障排查
drafts.body:
一位用户报告使用约3000个训练样本，通过LoRA对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-bnb-4bit进行分类任务的微调。其LoRA配置包括r=16，lora_alpha=16，lora_dropout=0，bias='none'，以及梯度检查点设置为“unsloth”。训练参数指定每设备批量大小为2，梯度累积16，训练3个epoch，学习率为2e-4，混合精度（根据硬件支持使用fp16或bf16），优化器为adamw_8bit。

尽管如此，模型在微调后对测试数据进行预测时，大约40%的时间会产生乱码输出。由于原因不明，关键问题是哪些诊断检查或指标最有助于区分问题是否源自数据质量、LoRA超参数、精度模式或训练稳定性。例如，监控损失曲线以检测过拟合或欠拟合，验证数据预处理一致性，或测试不同精度设置是否能提供有用见解？澄清这些问题有助于在此记录的配置中定位根本原因。
